title: The Late Set at the Blue Lantern

meta.scene: The drummer counts it off with the brushes still in his lap.
The tenor states the tune; the trumpet slides in under it.
The bridge. The bartender stops counting.
Back home, and the room is listening now.
He finds the thing he was looking for.
Up through the bridge, the drummer pushing him.
He brings it down and hands it back.
The head again, as if they never left.
The couple from the rain are dancing by the door.
Last eight bars of the night.
The tag: the turnaround once more, then the last chord, the cymbal ringing over the chairs going up on the tables.
